items.title: 定义真实 story replay 评分模型
items.context: 为 B-7670/B-8d6a/B-57e7/B-9c2c/B-990d/B-e452/B-78d2/B-6bee/B-8bcf 等真实任务计算可解释 score，并输出 why/explain。

happy.desc: 评分模型对 PASS 且 0 open bug 的真实 story 给出高分，并在 why 中列出 tests/bugs/summary 来源

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:4 WHY verifies high-score PASS story rows include score/why/explain source signals; severity=pass

edge.desc: 缺 summary 的旧 story 仍被纳入报告，但 score 降低且 explain 明确 artifact gap

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:19 WHY verifies missing summary stories remain in the report with lower score and artifact-gap explanation; severity=pass

adversarial.desc: score 不允许为空、NaN、超过 1 或缺少 why/explain，否则验证失败

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:35 WHY verifies every score is finite, bounded 0..1, and every row has why/explain; severity=pass

items.title: 实现 replay 报告生成入口
items.context: 新增可复跑命令或脚本，生成 experiments/reports/real-story-replay-v1.md/json，表格必须稳定包含 score、why、explain。

happy.desc: 运行 replay 脚本生成 real-story-replay-v1.md/json，并包含指定真实 story 行

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:51 WHY verifies replay script generates target real story rows in markdown/json; severity=pass

edge.desc: 重复运行 replay 脚本输出稳定，报告表头仍含 Score/Why/Explain

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:67 WHY verifies rerunning the replay is stable and keeps the required table shape; severity=pass

adversarial.desc: 报告不得只生成聊天式描述，必须同时有机器可读 JSON 和用户可读 Markdown

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:83 WHY verifies the output is not chat-only and writes both JSON and Markdown artifacts; severity=pass

items.title: 补 replay 报告回归验证
items.context: 验证报告包含指定真实 story、分数列、why/explain 解释列，并保证缺 summary 的旧 story 也能被解释。

happy.desc: 回归 fixture 校验 markdown 表格含 Story/Score/Why/Explain 且 B-9c2c 为高分

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:99 WHY validates markdown score table and B-9c2c high score evidence; severity=pass

edge.desc: 回归 fixture 校验 B-e452 缺 summary 时仍有分数和解释，不崩溃

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:115 WHY validates B-e452 missing-summary path does not crash and is explained; severity=pass

adversarial.desc: 回归 fixture 校验每个 replay item 都有 why 和 explain，缺任一字段即失败

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/real-story-replay-benchmark.json:131 WHY validates every replay item requires why and explain fields; severity=pass
